# Assessment Overview

This document serves as the navigation entry point for all supplementary assessment documents generated for the **WebApp-Storage-DotNet** (Azure Blob Storage Photo Gallery) application.

## Supplementary Documents

| Document | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| [Architecture Diagram](architecture-diagram.md) | High-level application architecture and component relationship diagrams, including technology stack summary and key architectural decisions |
| [Dependency Map](dependency-map.md) | Visual map of all external NuGet dependencies grouped by functional category, with version and compatibility risk analysis |
| [API & Service Contracts](api-service-contracts.md) | Full inventory of HTTP endpoints, communication patterns, service technology matrix, and request/response sequence diagrams |
| [Data Architecture](data-architecture.md) | Data persistence layer documentation covering Azure Blob Storage configuration, data ownership, entity model, and data sensitivity classification |
| [Configuration Inventory](configuration-inventory.md) | Comprehensive inventory of all configuration sources, properties, build/runtime profiles, secrets, and framework version matrix |
| [Business Workflows](business-workflows.md) | End-to-end documentation of core business workflows (browse, upload, delete), domain entities, business rules, and decision logic |
